Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Enum Class ServerOutput

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ServerOutput>
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.ServerOutput
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ServerOutput>, Constable
public enum ServerOutput extends Enum<ServerOutput>
How a database hands back the lines a routine printed — Oracle's DBMS_OUTPUT, PostgreSQL's RAISE NOTICE, and everyone else's JDBC warnings — decided from the connection URL alone.

Oracle buffers output until it is explicitly enabled and then only releases it through DBMS_OUTPUT.GET_LINE; PostgreSQL and most other drivers surface notices as SQLWarnings on the statement. Keeping the decision here, as a pure function of the URL, keeps JdbcService free of dialect branching and makes it unit-testable.
